variants.title: Collection vitrine and visit
variants.navigation: Collection, piece and craft links, a quiet visit link, rotation controls and a booking anchor.

ordered_sections.pattern: Centred ivory vitrine with a fine ring, corner label, small serif heading and one outlined action
Three portrait 4:5 plates with the middle plate lowered
Inline facet drawing beside a large numeral and four ruled steps
Paper booking panel beside a short invitation

variants.mobile_reflow: Label, tall stone stage, stone data, heading and action stack in that order; plates stack without offset; booking fields become one column.
distinguishing_features: Single centred stone in an empty ivory vitrine
Portrait collection plates with staggered rhythm
Craft drawing generated from the same proportions as the 3D stone

variants.title: Single piece and visit
variants.navigation: Breadcrumb back to the collection, choice controls, a reservation anchor and rotation controls.

ordered_sections.pattern: Sticky stone stage left, choice panel right
Same paper booking panel with the piece preselected

variants.mobile_reflow: Stone stage first at about 70 % of the screen, then title, choices, summary and booking in one column.
distinguishing_features: Split product page instead of a centred vitrine
Metal changes the claws in 3D and the ring render in the summary
Engraving shown on a metal band preview
